raw_text: {"competitors":[],"summary":"Dell Technologies' 10-K discusses competition only in generic terms — \"branded and generic competitors,\" \"companies that specialize in one or more of our product or service lines,\" \"non-traditional IT companies, including large Infrastructure-as-a-Service providers,\" and \"existing on-premises competitors\" — without naming any specific rival firm. Companies that do appear by name (EMC, VMware, Broadcom, SecureWorks, Sophos, Motorola, Caterpillar, Xerox, Snowflake, IonQ) are mentioned in historical, ownership, or executive-biography contexts, not as competitors. Accordingly, no qualifying competitors can be extracted."}
